title: Add lint-stability prober and granular dependency snapshotter
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a lightweight preflight prober that validates lint stability and produces a compact dependency snapshot used by presubmit gates. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: We continue to see transient lint flakes and dependency churn that cause spurious presubmit failures and noisy rollbacks. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) a lightweight 'lint-stability-prober' runnable in CI and locally to exercise lint rule bundles against a representative changed-file set to detect brittle rules before merge, and (2) a granular dependency snapshotter that records a compact fingerprint of direct+resolved dev deps per package manifest to accelerate presubmit dep-compat checks and to feed the dep-curation dashboard.

What this changes (high level):
- tools/preflight/prober: new small Go binary (150 LOC) that mirrors the lint runner invocation but retries only on local rule sources and emits a stability score for affected files.
- ci/presubmit: adds a new 'preflight-prober' step run on fastpath lanes (non-blocking for now, gated by a feature flag). The step uploads a JSON stability artifact to the CI artifact store.
- tools/deps/snapshotter: new Python helper to compute a deterministic dev-dep snapshot (manifest hash + resolved versions) for package types we touch (package.json, pyproject.toml).
- .github/workflows/presubmit.yml: small orchestration to wire the prober + snapshotter; the step is opt-in via PR label "preflight/probe" during rollout.
- docs/developer/ci-preflight.md: runbook and developer guide for using the prober locally and interpreting snapshots.

Checklist:

- [x] Wire opt-in presubmit step + upload artifacts
- [x] Add docs and example artifact to sample-artifacts/
- [x] Smoke-tested against redwood/sdk-python and redwood/redwood-docs changesets

Commits (summary):

- 7a12b21 implement local rule retry, stability score calculation, and JSON artifact format
- 3c91a8e add dev-dep snapshotter, manifest adapters for package.json and pyproject.toml
- b4e5f0a wire preflight step into presubmit workflow (opt-in label toggle)
- d1f2e44 docs: add preflight usage guide and artifact examples

Files/areas touched (illustrative snippets):
- tools/preflight/prober/main.go (new) -- exposes --files, --quiet, --output flags; stability scoring: 0..100
- tools/deps/snapshotter/snapshot.py (new) -- deterministic resolver that writes snapshot.json
- .github/workflows/presubmit.yml (modified) -- added 'preflight-prober' job that runs on fastpath lanes when label present
- docs/developer/ci-preflight.md (new) -- runbook and troubleshooting
- sample-artifacts/preflight/stability-sample.json (new) -- example artifact for dashboards

Small code excerpt (from main.go) included inline for reviewer convenience:
```
func scoreStability(results []LintResult) int {
    // simple heuristic: errors that appear on >80% of runs mark instability
    unstable := 0
    for _, r := range results {
        if r.OccurrenceRate > 0.8 {
            unstable++
        }
    }
    return int(100 * (1 - float64(unstable)/float64(len(results))))
}
```

Review conversation (high level):
- Liam O'Connor (requested changes): "Nice direction. Can we avoid expanding the presubmit 'fastpath' matrix? Suggested the opt-in label approach which you implemented. Also asked for clearer artifact TTLs in CI storage."
  - Author reply: "Changed to opt-in label; added TTL comment and 7-day default in workflow. Added a follow-up task ENG-2010 to revisit retention policy."
- Sofia Ramirez (comment): "Can the snapshotter be extended later for go.mod? if yes, please add an interface now."
  - Author reply: "Added a simple adapter interface in snapshot.py and an unimplemented go_mod adapter stub with TODO. Follow-up ticket ENG-2011 created."
- Ethan Mills (approval): "Approach looks safe; prober is opt-in and non-blocking. Approving after minor nits fixed."

CI summary:
- Initial run: lint failed in tools/deps/snapshotter due to a missing dev dependency in the test harness; fixed via 3c91a8e.
- Second run: unit tests passed; flaky lint detected in prober tests on macOS runner; we disabled linux/mac matrix duplicate and added a 1s jitter in test harness.
- Final run: all checks green; artifacts uploaded to CI storage and sample artifact available at artifacts/729101/stability-sample.json

Rollout notes and follow-ups:
- The preflight prober is behind opt-in label 'preflight/probe' while we monitor artifact size and TTL (ENG-2010).
- Added dashboard tile in observability-pack to surface recent stability-sample.json artifacts and to surface rules with the lowest stability score.
- Follow-up tasks: ENG-2011 (extend snapshotter to go.mod), ENG-2012 (auto-suggest dep-curation PRs from snapshot diffs), ENG-2013 (evaluate promoting prober to blocking gate after 4 weeks of stable telemetry).

Why this is safe to merge now: prober/jobs are opt-in and non-blocking; no changes to runtime or production code paths; artifacts are scoped to dev deps and CI artifacts only. The new tools are small, unit-tested, and documented. Merge method: squash.

Merge outcome: merged via squash to main after 2 approvals and CI green.

If you want to run locally: see docs/developer/ci-preflight.md for quickstart (go build ./tools/preflight/prober && python tools/deps/snapshotter/snapshot.py --manifest package.json --output snapshot.json).
